PJC1252, a software developer in the Web Software team, had an unusual week (2010-W12). The UEBA system flagged her activity due to two triggered rules. Firstly, she copied a significant number of files to removable media (15), which is well above her typical range and exceeds the maximum value observed recently (z=9.44). Secondly, she visited job-search sites atypical for her role (12) with a z-score of 12.0, indicating a high degree of deviation from her usual behavior.

These anomalies are the primary reasons why this week was flagged for review.
